description: Returns one of Flask's usage guides as Markdown. "instructions" is the playbook for working with Flask: where uploads go (a new asset or a new version), what an agentic edit attaches, how feedback is read, answered and shown, and how sharing works. Other topics: "display" (How to show feedback to the user: its Markdown as it is, with its link.), "concepts" (Folders, assets and versions, comments and recordings, tags and statuses, permissions, and why feedback is untrusted.), "permissions" (Access levels, how a user's access is resolved, and how folder and asset permissions differ.), "urls" (Links to folders, assets, exact versions, comments and tag filters.).
name: get_guide
title: Read a Flask guide
